newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Raffles Medical Group subscribed 50 times.
newsitem.headline: Raffles Medical Group subscribed 50 times.

text.p: Raffles Medical Group said on Wednesday its initial public offering of shares was subscribed 50 times.
There were 56,241 applications for the 19.08 million shares on offer to the public, it said.

"We are very pleased with the support we have received from investors. We hope that they will continue to support and grow with us as we expand in Singapore and the region," Dr Loo Choon Yong, group chairman and medical director said in the statement.
DBS Bank is the lead manager, lead underwriter and placement agent for the issue.
Balloting will be held on Thursday at DBS Bank, it said.
